verdict.rationale: A government payroll-tax e-Services portal could plausibly offer a test or sandbox environment for filers or payroll software, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only production e-Services functions (registration, filing, payments) and shows no sandbox or test environment. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, and the transactional portal host returned 403.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
